summary:
Iteration 25 verified the security-audit remediation set: demo passwords removed from bundle, DEMO_MODE=false production seed gating, jurisdiction regex escape, forgot-password enumeration parity, and .gitignore .env coverage. Backend pytest /app/backend/tests/test_security_remediation.py: 11/11 passed (JUnit /app/test_reports/pytest/iter25_results.xml).

SECRETS DETECTED (values NOT printed): AISSTREAM_API_KEY=PRESENT, RESEND_API_KEY=PRESENT, JWT_SECRET=PRESENT, ADMIN_PASSWORD=PRESENT, MONGO_URL=PRESENT, DB_NAME=PRESENT, DEMO_MODE=PRESENT (=false confirmed), APP_ENV=PRESENT (=production confirmed). frontend/.env: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL PRESENT, REACT_APP_DEMO_PASSWORDS ABSENT. git check-ignore backend/.env frontend/.env -> both ignored.

BUNDLE (/app/frontend/build/static/js/main.e5a8b95d.js): grep 'Analyst#2026'=0, 'Supervisor#2026'=0, 'REACT_APP_DEMO_PASSWORDS'=0. Two 40-hex-char decimal-digit substrings found but they are LN10 mantissa digits from decimal.js (context '2.30258509299404568401799...'), NOT hex API-key tokens. Login page /login: demo-login-analyst prefills email='analyst@sentinelmar.demo' password=''; demo-login-supervisor prefills email='supervisor@sentinelmar.demo' password=''. Helper text visible ('DEMO ACCOUNTS ... Demo buttons pre-fill the email only', truncated in log).

PRODUCTION STARTUP: /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log latest startup contains 'AISStream API key configured: True' followed by 'Application startup complete.' followed by seed log 'seed: {seeded: False, reason: LIVE mode — demo seeding disabled}'. No 'seeded: True' anywhere after latest startup. GET /api/health -> environment=production, demo_mode=false, database=online, ais.key_configured=true, ais.state in allowed enum (200 OK). GET /api/ais/status (analyst auth) -> 200, state in enum, no 'APIKey' string, no >=40 char hex tokens. GET /api/system/health -> data_mode.mode='PRODUCTION'.

LOGIN: POST /api/auth/login analyst -> 200 access_token, role=analyst. Admin -> 200, role=admin. Wrong password single attempt -> 401 (avoided full 5-fail lockout to preserve analyst account for other tests). UI login via /login form succeeds; dashboard shows nav-stat-cases=115.

PASSWORD RESET: POST /api/auth/forgot-password with real analyst email -> 200 with message + delivery (in {'email','logged'}). POST with 'nobody-xyz@example.org' -> 200 with IDENTICAL keys, delivery='email'. Admin GET /api/auth/reset-requests lists ANALYST_EMAIL and does NOT contain 'nobody-xyz@example.org'. Skipped completing the reset flow (delivery='email' via Resend — token not retrievable through API) to avoid changing analyst password.

JURISDICTION SEARCH: GET /api/jurisdictions?q=(a+)+$ (authenticated) -> 200 in 1.77 s total (well under 2 s), no ReDoS. q=Japan -> 200 with JPN token present.

REGRESSION: /api/dashboard/summary -> 200. UI dashboard renders 115/115/42 counters. Only console errors were two pre-login 401s from /api/auth/me cookie probes (expected).
action_items: (Docs, non-blocking) /app/memory/test_credentials.md line 'Login page demo buttons pre-fill passwords only when REACT_APP_DEMO_PASSWORDS is set in frontend/.env' is now stale — REACT_APP_DEMO_PASSWORDS was intentionally removed by this security remediation. Update the note to reflect that demo buttons now pre-fill email only, no password path exists in the client bundle.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/.env and frontend/.env correctly ignored by git (.gitignore rules '.env' + '*/.env' with '!.env.example' exceptions).

Bundle audit clean: no plaintext demo passwords, no REACT_APP_DEMO_PASSWORDS references, no hex API-key tokens. The two 40-char digit matches are LN10 constant digits from decimal.js and are safe false positives; would recommend future audits use hex-only regex '[a-fA-F][a-f0-9]{39}' or entropy-based checks to eliminate this noise.
Forgot-password enumeration parity is enforced: response shape and keys are identical for known vs unknown emails and 'delivery=email' is used to mask non-existence.
Jurisdiction search regex-escaped path returns quickly on ReDoS payload '(a+)+$' — 200 in <2 s, no catastrophic backtracking.

Production startup gate confirmed: seed log always reports 'seeded: False, reason: LIVE mode — demo seeding disabled' when DEMO_MODE=false, so supervisor/analyst demo accounts are seeded only in demo builds (analyst/supervisor rows in preview DB are pre-existing seed data, not newly created).
test_credentials: analyst@sentinelmar.demo / Analyst#2026, admin shawpriyanshu950@gmail.com / Admin#2026 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Analyst was used for 1 wrong-password attempt only (well below the 5-fail lockout).
seed_data_creation: None. No DB writes. Password reset flow was NOT completed (delivery='email' via Resend — token not retrievable). Analyst password remains 'Analyst#2026'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AISStream shared-key situation from iter24 persists (state fluctuates between CONNECTING and OFFLINE, reason 'Another client is using this AISStream API key'). Not a regression. RESEND_API_KEY is configured so forgot-password delivery='email' path is exercised; if you need to complete the reset-password flow end-to-end you must either (a) admin-read the token via /api/auth/reset-requests (works only when delivery='logged', i.e. Resend down), or (b) use the admin PUT /api/users/{id} path to set a password and then revert. Do NOT trigger 5 failed login attempts on the analyst account — lockout is 15 min. Bundle hash: main.e5a8b95d.js.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all remediation checks passed. Only a documentation drift item: /app/memory/test_credentials.md still references REACT_APP_DEMO_PASSWORDS which no longer exists in frontend/.env or bundle.
